en.headline: Hong Kong Wine and Dine Festival returns at Central Harbourfront from 29 October
en.dek: The four-day event features more than 340 booths from 31 countries and regions, with star chefs and a new Coffee Village section, running into the early hours on Friday and Saturday.
body: The Hong Kong Tourism Board said the 2026 Hong Kong Wine and Dine Festival will take place from 29 October to 1 November at the Central Harbourfront and Tamar Park.

More than 340 booths representing 31 countries and regions are expected. South Korea, Australia and Canada will participate for the first time, and the venue has been expanded to include Tamar Park. Operating hours will extend to 1 a.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.

The organisers said star chefs Edward Lee and Choi Hyun-seok will appear at collaborative dining experiences in the Tasting Room pop-up. A special dinner on 30 October will feature five renowned chefs under the theme The Taste of Time. A Coffee Village section will gather 14 local and international coffee and beverage brands with workshops and music programmes.

The festival is set against Victoria Harbour and includes rare vintages from major wine regions. Details of specific sessions and ticketing arrangements are available through the Tourism Board’s channels.

zh.headline: 香港美酒佳餚巡禮10月29日起中環海濱舉行
zh.dek: 四日活動設超過340個來自31個國家及地區的攤位，有星級廚師及新增咖啡園專區，周五六延至凌晨1時。
body: 香港旅遊發展局表示，2026年香港美酒佳餚巡禮將於10月29日至11月1日在中環海濱及添馬公園舉行。
預計有超過340個攤位，來自31個國家及地區。南韓、澳洲及加拿大首次參與，場地擴展至添馬公園。周五及周六營業時間延至凌晨1時。
主辦單位表示，星級廚師Edward Lee及崔鉉碩將於品鑑室臨時餐廳的合作用餐體驗中登場。10月30日有以「時間的味道」為主題的特別晚宴，由五位名廚參與。咖啡園專區匯聚14個本地及國際咖啡與飲品品牌，設工作坊及音樂節目。
活動以維多利亞港為背景，包括主要產區的稀有葡萄酒。具體環節及購票安排可透過旅發局渠道查詢。
